title: Canonical Rich-Text Document
description: Project-owned run/paragraph rich-text model. NOT an archived NSAttributedString/AttributedString. Stores only application-supported formatting. Text is Unicode scalars normalized to NFC; run boundaries are scalar offsets (not Swift String.Index). Schema version 1.

text.description: Full plain text in NFC, Unicode scalars. The source of truth for characters; runs reference offsets into this string.

paragraphs.description: Ordered paragraphs. A paragraph covers a contiguous scalar range and carries paragraph-level style.

startScalar.description: Inclusive start scalar offset into text.

endScalar.description: Exclusive end scalar offset into text.

style.description: Paragraph style. body = normal prose; heading = simple heading; bullet = bulleted list item.

runs.description: Ordered text runs within this paragraph. Unstyled ranges need no run. Overlapping marks are expressed via a marks set on each run.

marks.description: Supported marks only. Unsupported/private attributes MUST NOT appear here.

link.description: Optional link target (web/email/phone) auto-detected or set by user.

hardBreak.description: Explicit hard line break at end of run.
